changes: Track-owned temporal evidence; one observation per frame; explicit local pass/fail/present result replaces object-identity side channel.
Central coordinate reset for probe/direct rotation changes; archive shots, clear coordinate-bound live state, and wait for the next frame instead of seeding old-coordinate tracks.

issues: Nearby dogs counted as repeated observations, depending on processing order.
A new track inherited the previous track's evidence at the same location.
Rotation reset immediately seeded new tracks from old-coordinate detections.

structural_cost.history_scan: For T tracks with W recent observations each: global per-candidate filtering can inspect O(T^2 W) records per frame; track-owned filtering inspects O(T W). This is bookkeeping, not a claim about total frame speed.
structural_cost.scope: Normal two-video paths remain exact. Targeted multi-track/rotation cases intentionally change to reject borrowed evidence and stale coordinates.

method.hardware: Intel Core i9-13980HX, Windows 11, CPUExecutionProvider; RTX 4060 unused.

benchmark.micro_sampling: uniform across each whole video; sequential decode; interleaved videos
benchmark.inference: prepared CPU tensor to returned CPU outputs, including GPU transfers/synchronization
benchmark.capture_to_result: submission to result, including worker queue; excludes camera/driver
benchmark.scheduled_to_result: scheduled video PTS to result, including producer lateness
benchmark.excluded: preview/UI rendering, network, Re-ID, final image saving; models warm before replay
benchmark.startup: new model sessions in an existing Python process; OS file cache not flushed

method.runtime: Same compiled CPU layout models/config in both groups; HighQoS, ORT 4 threads, 1000 us spin/backoff 8, OpenCV 1 thread.
method.video_order: User then Wolfhound in A; reversed in B. Runs serial, no profiler.
method.pooling: Pool individual frame timings; do not average per-run percentiles.
limitations: CPU frequency and external system load not locked; no worst-case latency guarantee.
Dropped-frame trials can have different subsequent work/selection; not an equal-work speed comparison.
Two-video equivalence and synthetic boundary tests do not measure broader animal-identification accuracy.
SDK tests/typecheck/build passed; no new real phone throughput/energy or WebGPU/WASM model accuracy benchmark.
Missing-frame sensitivity of recurrent crop tracking and relative detection schedules remains outside these fixes.
